title: Father Holding Baby, 1947 Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot from May 1, 1947, depicting a well-dressed father in a suit holding his infant outdoors. The baby is wearing a light bonnet and wrapped in a soft blanket. A residential home with horizontal siding and a classic post-war era automobile are visible in the background, offering a timeless glimpse into suburban American family life in the late 1940s.
